schema: 1
package: webspec-semantics

rules:
  - id: event-fire-generic
    description: The DOM fire-an-event primitive is an intrinsic event effect. The name is unknown until a caller provides a supported literal.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-fire
    emit:
      kind: event.fire
      params:
        name: null
  - id: event-fire-literal-name
    description: Recover a literal event name when the complete fire operation is present at the linked reference.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-fire
      text: '(?i)\b(?:fire|firing) an event named (?P<name>`[^`]+`|\*[^*]+\*)'
    emit:
      kind: event.fire
      params:
        name:
          capture: name
          from: literal
    expect:
      - direct-two-sites
      - variable-name
      - named-event-note
      - multiple-event-operations
      - mention-only
      - navigation-history-events
      - inflected-event-names
  - id: event-fire-code-name
    description: Recover the event name from the unquoted code-token spelling used by HTML for fixed event names such as popstate and hashchange. The capture excludes variable tokens and quoted code.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-fire
      text: '(?i)\b(?:fire|firing) an event named `(?P<name>[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)`'
    emit:
      kind: event.fire
      params:
        name:
          capture: name
          from: text
    expect:
      - navigation-history-events
      - inflected-event-names
      - queued-event-boundary
  - id: event-dispatch-generic
    description: Dispatch is a separate DOM operation from firing; generic dispatch keeps its name unknown.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-dispatch
    emit:
      kind: event.dispatch
      params:
        name: null
    expect:
      - navigation-dispatch
      - dispatch-initialization-negative
  - id: navigation-dispatch-name
    description: "Reviewed Navigation API case: initialization of the NavigateEvent type does not itself dispatch; the later dispatch operation is scoped to this algorithm and reports the known navigate name."
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-dispatch
      subject: HTML#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm
      text: '(?i)dispatching\s+\*event\*\s+at\s+\*navigation\*'
    emit:
      kind: event.dispatch
      params:
        name: navigate
    expect:
      - navigation-dispatch
      - dispatch-initialization-negative

    match:

      text: '(?i)queue an element task (?:on|using) (?:the |\*[^*]+\*[''’]s |the media element[''’]s )?(?P<source>embed task source|media element event task source|canvas blob serialization task source|speculation rules task source|JavaScript engine task source|microtask task source|DOM manipulation task source|user interaction task source|networking task source|navigation and traversal task source|rendering task source|timer task source|bitmap task source|remote event task source|posted message task source|port message queue|unshipped port message queue)\b'

summaries:
- id: wait-for-all
  subject: WEBIDL#wait-for-all
  expect_text: PerformPromiseThen
  reason: This reviewed Web IDL primitive schedules success and failure continuations
    through promise jobs; the declaration is intrinsic and does not claim every branch
    runs.
  emit:
    kind: scheduling.promise-continuation
    params: {}
  continuations: separate
rules:

  description: The document update algorithm explicitly permits author script execution
    after a new document is committed.
  match:
    subject: HTML#update-document-for-history-step-application
    text: (?i)At this point scripts may run for the newly-created document
  emit:
    kind: script.opportunity
    params: {}
  expect:
  - queued-event-boundary
